delete_all_claim_state.reason: no consensus record from which the owner can prove amount, identity, and unspent status

retain_owner_receipt_only.reason: a signed receipt alone cannot establish that it was not already spent; needs consensus-visible replay/nullifier state and an authenticated anchor

retain_receipt_and_nullifier_index.reason: spend/replay state and data availability remain live until claim is consumed

renewal_censored_during_grace.unless: consensus keeps the claim live and accepts a proof/exit independent of the censored lease renewal

conservation: expiry may delete state only after all monetary rights are consumed or made unspendable; preserving rights requires persistent consensus-visible anti-replay state and available proof data
